prompt: In a dot plot, a region with no dots is called a:
hint: Think of the ordinary word for an empty space between two things.

hints.text: Think of the ordinary word for an empty space between two things.
If no data values fall in part of the number line, the dot plot shows a blank stretch there with dots on either side. The name is a short, three-letter word.
A region with no dots is called a gap.

explanation: Dots on a dot plot show where data values are, so a stretch with no dots has no data values.
Such an empty stretch separates the groups of dots on either side of it.
A region of a dot plot with no dots is called a gap.
